name: MYMBN Berhad
overview: MYMBN Berhad 于2026年完成收购 Swallows House Enterprise Sdn. Bhd. 70% 股权，将该公司纳入集团；公司未公告任何业务板块缩减或退出。
overview_en: MYMBN Berhad completed the acquisition of a 70% equity interest in Swallows House Enterprise Sdn. Bhd. in 2026, bringing the company into the group; it also proposed a bonus issue of up to 193,000,000 warrants and the establishment of an employees' share option scheme. No segment downsizing or exit was announced.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 集团层面完成对 Swallows House Enterprise Sdn. Bhd. 70% 股权的收购。
segments.note_en: At group level, the acquisition of a 70% equity interest in Swallows House Enterprise Sdn. Bhd. was completed, and a bonus issue of warrants and an employees' share option scheme were proposed.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text_en: Proposed a bonus issue of up to 193,000,000 warrants on the basis of 1 warrant for every 2 existing ordinary shares, and proposed an employees' share option scheme of up to 30.0% of the total number of issued shares.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 收购 Swallows House Enterprise Sdn. Bhd. 70% 股权在支付余额后视为完成。
actions.text_en: The acquisition of a 70% equity interest in Swallows House Enterprise Sdn. Bhd. was deemed completed following payment of the balance consideration.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 签订股份买卖协议，以现金代价 RM2,588,000 收购 Swallows House Enterprise Sdn. Bhd. 70% 股权。
actions.text_en: Entered into a share sale and purchase agreement to acquire a 70% equity interest in Swallows House Enterprise Sdn. Bhd. for a cash consideration of RM2,588,000.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 通过收购 Swallows House Enterprise Sdn. Bhd. 70% 股权，将该公司纳入集团。
model_changes.text_en: Bringing Swallows House Enterprise Sdn. Bhd. into the group through the acquisition of a 70% equity interest.
